purpose: Teach: 課す/形容/メンツ/熟知/表向き/細々/退会/寄附

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、新人にも一定の責務を課す制度ですね
lines.en: It's a system where we hold new officers to a certain standard of responsibility.
lines.style: Even, measured tone. Professional but not stiff. A brief pause before beginning, settling into the explanation with steady conviction. No performance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、容疑者の特徴を簡潔に形容されますね
lines.en: Yes — and you describe suspects very clearly and concisely.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Slightly deferential without being obsequious. Warm enough to show genuine recognition. Simple, direct delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、関係機関のメンツを保つご配慮、ありがたいです
lines.en: We appreciate how thoughtfully you handle the standing of other agencies.
lines.style: Earnest gratitude, almost careful. A slight dip in energy — this matters to him. Not flattery, genuine relief. Quiet, sincere.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、地域の事情を熟知した捜査官を配置します
lines.en: We station investigators who know the local situation well.
lines.style: Factual, procedural. No apology in the tone. Confident in the method. Slight pause after the opening, like checking that the listener understands the point being made.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、表向きの捜査と内偵捜査を併用なさるんですね
lines.en: Yes — so you use both open investigation and undercover work together.
lines.style: Recognizing understanding. A small note of respect in the intonation. Not questioning — confirming his grasp. Engaged and attentive.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、細々した情報も大事にします
lines.en: We pay attention to even the smallest pieces of information.
lines.style: Quiet insistence. Not defensive, just clear. A slight emphasis on 'even' — important to say this aloud. Steady, no hurry.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、防犯協会の退会を防ぐ呼びかけ、ありがたいです
lines.en: We're grateful for your efforts to keep members in the crime prevention association.
lines.style: Sincere thanks, softly expressed. A moment of real appreciation in the voice. Not perfunctory. Warm and direct.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、市民からの寄附は丁重にお断りします
lines.en: We respectfully decline donations from citizens.
lines.style: Polite but firm boundary. Not cold — genuinely respectful of the impulse. Clear and final without being harsh. The kind of 'no' that feels kind.
